description:
Not everything worth discovering is right in front of you.

Some ideas exist just beyond the obvious, waiting to be noticed, explored, and brought to life. Hackinverse is a 24-hour hackathon for those who aren't afraid to chase the unexpected, question what's possible, and build what others can't yet see.

Step into an experience where curiosity drives every decision, creativity outpaces convention, and collaboration turns ambitious ideas into reality. Whether you're a developer, designer, or innovator, you'll spend the next 24 hours solving real problems, learning from mentors, pushing your limits, and creating something extraordinary alongside a community that shares your passion.

Expect late-night breakthroughs, endless brainstorming, caffeine-fueled conversations, exciting challenges, and moments you'll remember long after the final submission. After all, the most interesting things rarely happen in broad daylight.

Some signals are easy to miss, but the best builders never ignore them.

Welcome to Hackinverse.
Join our [WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/DZFNMGtNxnm4PMqraUHXnY?s=sw&p=a&ilr=4) Community

hackathon_faqs.answer: Students from any college or university are welcome to participate.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes! You can register as an individual. You may also form a team before the hackathon begins.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I register without a team?

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackInverse 1.0 is an offline hackathon and will be held in Kolkata, India.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is it an online or offline hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. Every participant must register on Devfolio and join the same team.
hackathon_faqs.question: Do all team members need to register on Devfolio?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Bring your laptop, charger, college ID, and any other hardware you plan to use. Internet connectivity and power will be provided at the venue.
hackathon_faqs.question: What should I bring?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Participants are expected to build their project during the hackathon. You may come with ideas and do general research beforehand.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we start working on our project before the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. You are encouraged to use open-source tools, APIs, and frameworks, provided you comply with their licenses and clearly mention them during submission.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we use existing open-source libraries or APIs?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Projects will be evaluated based on:

Innovation & Creativity
Technical Implementation
Problem Solving
User Experience
Presentation & Demo
hackathon_faqs.question: How will projects be judged?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. Meals and refreshments will be provided to all registered participants during the event.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will food and refreshments be provided?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. All eligible participants will receive certificates, and winners will receive prizes and additional rewards announced during the event.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will participants receive certificates?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Reach out to us at hackinverse.contact@gmail.com or contact us through our social media channels.
hackathon_faqs.question: What if I face issues while registering?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes! Inter-college teams are welcome. Team members can belong to different colleges or universities.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can my team have members from different colleges?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No worries! Join our [WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/DZFNMGtNxnm4PMqraUHXnY?s=sw&p=a&ilr=4) community and connect with other participants looking for teammates. We have dedicated channels for team formation where you can find like-minded hackers before the event.
hackathon_faqs.question: I don't have a team. How can I find teammates?

Participants can build anything based on the following themes: AI/ML, Hardware, web3. Participants are also welcomed for open innovation.
